title: Injectivity of the switching encoding
statement: Let $n,w,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates with width at most $w$. The map sending each restriction for which the restricted formula has decision-tree depth at least $k+1$ to its associated pair consisting of a target restriction and a switching code of length $k+1$ is injective.
